definitions.gloss: authoritative power; coercive authority; strong-arm tactics
definitions.explanation: The use of forceful, often oppressive authority to impose one's will. Implies power exercised without regard for opposition or democratic process.

examples.japanese: {強権|きょうけん}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧な⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{強権|きょうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発動|はつどう}→発動：28234_hatsudou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦デモ→デモ：19416_demo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鎮圧|ちんあつ}→鎮圧：14542_chinatsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The government exercised coercive power to suppress the demonstration.

examples.japanese: {強権|きょうけん}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧な⟦リーダーシップ→リーダーシップ：09596_riidaashippu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}する→対する：02126_taisuru⟧⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}まっている→高まる：02066_takamaru⟧。
examples.english: Criticism of authoritarian leadership is growing.

notes:
{強権|きょうけん} refers to coercive or authoritarian power — the forceful exercise of authority without regard for opposition or civil liberties.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {強権|きょうけん}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧: authoritarian (na-adjective)
- {強権|きょうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発動|はつどう}→発動：28234_hatsudou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to exercise coercive power
- {強権|きょうけん}⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧: authoritarian politics
- {強権|きょうけん}⟦{体制|たいせい}→体制：04490_taisei⟧: authoritarian regime
- {強権|きょうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}るう→振るう：12793_furuu⟧: to wield coercive power

USAGE:
Almost always carries a negative connotation, implying abuse of power or suppression of rights. Frequently appears in news and political commentary.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{権力|けんりょく}→権力：10020_kenryoku⟧: power, authority (neutral)
- ⟦{独裁|どくさい}→独裁：05969_dokusai⟧: dictatorship (more extreme)
- ⟦{圧政|あっせい}→圧政：12133_assei⟧: oppressive rule, tyranny
